# [PR #14229] [None][test] Add verl standalone E2E weight-sync guard

source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/14229
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-26T03:41:43Z
labels: 

## 正文

Adds `test_verl_E2E_standalone.py` to the verl post-merge CI stage. This is layered on top of #14227, which itself stacks on #14037.

The test runs ~3 GRPO trainer steps via verl’s `tests/special_e2e/run_fully_async_policy.sh` on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct + GSM8K, using an FSDP2 trainer on 2 GPUs and standalone TRT-LLM rollout on 2 GPUs. It asserts that each step’s `actor/ppo_kl < 0.05`, meaning the trainer and rollout policies stay within ±5% of each other under `bypass_mode=True`.

This is tighter than #14227’s convergence test, which uses a 0.1 bound. With `bypass_mode=True`, `old_log_probs` come directly from the rollout engine, so `actor/ppo_kl` directly measures `KL(pi_trainer || pi_rollout)`. With bit-correct weight sync, the ratio is theoretically 1; floating-point and dtype-cast noise stay under 5%. A weight-sync regression, such as a broken parameter group, dtype mismatch, or dropped allreduce, drives `ppo_kl` well above 0.05 on the first PPO step.
